text:
Marco (AE): Quick sync: Tessera (prospect) wants a 5-day POC using an experimental community model 'zephyr-35b-qlora' for long-context docs (6k tokens). They asked if Redwood can: run a dedicated small pool, keep persistent KV between user sessions, and export inference traces to their DataDog. Also asked for a fixed trial price.
Sara (Solutions Eng): 6k token context is outside our normal default. We can support up to 8k but need to confirm memory/latency tradeoffs and whether the qlora layout uses stitched attention offsets. Do we have the model artifact?
Marco (AE): They uploaded a manifest and a .bin link. Manifest snippet they pasted: 
```
name: zephyr-35b-qlora
vocab: 50000
hidden: 32768
heads: 64
rotary_pct: 0.5
default_seq: 6144
quant: qlora
license: sc-sample-1.0
```
Ilya (Inference Eng): qlora variants vary a lot. Need exact tokenizer and attention matrix format. KV memory estimate first pass: seq*hidden*(k+v)/bytes-per-param but qlora compression reduces weights not KV. At 6k we should plan ~50-60GB KV for 35b. Will test on a 80GB GPU node.
Rina (Security): Two asks: 1) license audit - ensure it permits eval in Hosted/Dedicated; 2) if we accept customer-provided weights, Legal needs a weigh-chain + checksum and we must record chain-of-custody. Also DataDog integration is fine but need to redact token-level payloads.
Omar (Pricing): For 5-day reserved: propose flat fee covering 1x 80GB GPU (dedicated) + 20% buffer. Include clause: if model variant fails validation, customer pays 50% refund. I'll draft numbers. Any required ingress/egress limits?
Marco (AE): They want metrics to include latency histograms and token counts. Will provide DataDog API key and allow IP whitelist.
Sara (Solutions Eng): Operational plan: 1) vet model artifacts + license 2) run short import smoke on infra-qa 3) canary deploy to 1 instance with fallback to zephyr-35b-fp16-redwood if OOM/regression. Canary rollout: 2% -> 25% -> 100% over 24-48h. Enable prefix KV caching and session affinity.
Ilya (Inference Eng): I'll run bench tonight and post a short table: p50/p95 @ 1 rps, memory usage, kv size, batch=1, batch=4. If qlora weights cause jitter, we recommend our prevalidated variant.
Rina (Security): Also request: include a minimal network diagram from Tessera for the VPC peering if they want Dedicated in their cloud. We'll start a security intake once license arrives.
legal-bot: created ticket LEG-8942 for model-weights-acceptance; assigned to Legal.
Marco (AE): Next steps from my side: send NDA + SOW, collect license + checksum, ask for DataDog endpoint. Sara/Ilya/Omar please upload perf + draft quote by EOD so we can get Tessera signoff.
Sara (Solutions Eng): ack. I'll post perf link to #artifacts/4387654321/bench.txt when ready.
Ilya (Inference Eng): bench uploaded. Summary: zephyr-35b-qlora on an 80GB node at seq=6144, batch=1 -> p95 ~ 720ms, KV ~ 58GB, stable for <2k active tokens/session. Notes: long-lived sessions above 3k tokens risk OOM without sharding.
Omar (Pricing): Draft quote in drive: /deals/tessera/trial_quote_v1.pdf. Includes refund clause and variant-vetting fee.
Rina (Security): I'll review license when Marco posts it. If license disallows commercial use we'll limit to internal eval only and notify Tessera.
Marco (AE): Thanks team. Keeping thread open until license + SOW are accepted. :pushpin:
